trial_type.Description: Controlled category of the event represented by the row.

Levels.trial_start: Interval beginning at the trial-start marker.
Levels.listening_cue: Presentation of the sentence audio cue.
Levels.listening_word: Word timing within the sentence audio cue.
Levels.listening_syllable: Syllable timing within the sentence audio cue.
Levels.repetition_cue: Cue and interval for repeating the sentence.
Levels.repetition_word: Observed spoken word during sentence repetition.
Levels.repetition_syllable: Observed spoken syllable during sentence repetition.
Levels.syllabification_cue: Cue for one syllable in the syllabification phase.

phase.Description: Controlled trial phase to which the event belongs.

Levels.trial_start: Trial interval beginning at the trial-start marker.

trial_index.Description: One-based trial number within the run.

token.Description: Orthographic word or phonetic syllable associated with the event; the linguistic level is encoded by trial_type.

token_index.Description: One-based temporal position within each trial_index and trial_type sequence.

event_source.Description: Annotation source used to create the row.

Levels.gdf_trigger: Paired onset and offset markers from the GDF recording.
Levels.textgrid_word: Word interval from a TextGrid annotation.
Levels.textgrid_syllable: Syllable interval from a TextGrid annotation.

stimulus_id.Description: Stable identifier of the sentence stimulus.

stim_file.Description: Path to the presented stimulus relative to /stimuli.
